alsoGreen.intent: Structured Text instead of Ladder: the SR and RS function blocks

files.src/AlarmLatchLd.st:
PROGRAM AlarmLatchLd
VAR_INPUT Fault AT %I0.0 : BOOL; Ack AT %I0.1 : BOOL; END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT SetFirst AT %Q0.0 : BOOL; ResetFirst AT %Q0.1 : BOOL; END_VAR
VAR SetLatch : SR; ResetLatch : RS; END_VAR
SetLatch(S1 := Fault, R := Ack); SetFirst := SetLatch.Q1;
ResetLatch(S := Fault, R1 := Ack); ResetFirst := ResetLatch.Q1;
END_PROGRAM

wrong.intent: has no memory: both alarms are plain coils that follow Fault
never lets Ack clear the alarms: there are no RESET rungs
puts the RESET rung of SetFirst last, so Ack wins when it arrives with Fault
puts the SET rung of ResetFirst last, so Fault wins when it arrives with Ack
